test_title: PYST 8: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 01 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
M, N, O, P, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

Only two people sit between X and W when counted from the right of X. Only two people sit between W and M when counted from the right of W. Only three people sit between X and N when counted from the right of X. P sits to the immediate left of Y. Who sits third to the left of O?
solution: Persons: M, N, O, P, W, X, Y All face centre **Circular arrangement (facing centre → right = anticlockwise, left = clockwise)** 2 persons between X and W from right of X [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/770578852366ba164d3be57fc38bc3c6312ad77be4ed050980c31cd0e3712e38.png] 2 persons between W and M from right of W
